title: Chapter 982
paragraphs: Chapter 982
Episode 243.
The Red King's Ambush (2)
At that time, Kelliark was drinking tea with Ragal and examining Elona's report.
It was the records about the captured enemy's air fortress, Usu. As Shimat had anticipated, she was analyzing Usu by utilizing the ability of the sacred vessel and synthesizing Gaila.
“Was it because of the lack of blood? Owning such a tremendous device, yet being dragged around by the royal family, it's hard for me to understand.”
“I feel the same, Kelliark friend. Until the Wall of Sealing was created, the Red Plutonian and Blue Plutonian clans were really terrifying.”
As Ragal answered, Kelliark suddenly sharpened her senses.
She could feel an immense force approaching Drakka from somewhere very far away. Among all the people in Drakka, only Kelliark was aware of the change.
“Wait, Ragal.”
“What is it, Kelliark friend?”
“Something strong is approaching Drakka. But it's hard to pinpoint the direction...”
“Eh? Really? Could it be a surprise attack from the Alliance? Weren't there no unusual reports from the spies we sent over there?”
Kelliark stood up from her seat.
“Mobilize all troops, go into first-level defensive stance. It's an enemy invasion.”
“Yes!”
The nearby mages began to swiftly propagate Kelliark's command. Then, Kelliark went outside and raised the fire seal to signal the invasion once more.
The city walls rose even higher, constructing an iron fortress, and a massive shield was formed, overlapping from the sky to the Zipple's headquarters.
All these processes took less than five minutes to complete. Being the capital of the federation and the home of Zipple, Drakka's defenses were arguably the best in the world.
If the enemies had attempted a conventional raid, attacking and infiltrating from the outside, Drakka could have successfully minimized the damage.
However, a surprise attack ‘from underground’ was a move that Kelliark had not anticipated at all.
Krrrddddd...!
The first to feel the vibration were the civilians in the southern part of Drakka.
“Is it an earthquake!?”
“Aaaahh!”
As the two civilians who were heading home screamed, the entire ground collapsed, and a huge, red beam of light shot up.
The main cannon of the Red Plutonian fleet's flagship, Lavieth, had fired. Dozens of nearby civilians were swept up by the cannon and disappeared without a trace, melted away.
Literally, the ground and buildings were turning over as if they were liquid.
The mages, who were hurrying back to the headquarters after confirming the state of emergency, also met death without even being able to scream from the ensuing bombardment.
When they declared war on Zipple in the past.
The Red Plutonian clan said they would never cause civilian casualties during the war. But now, they were indiscriminately killing every human in sight.
“Save me!”
“Help, help me...! Aaah!”
From the ground and the fleet that had just risen to the sky, artillery fire was pouring down relentlessly.
With every shot, the massive red energy waves swallowed up several buildings at once, and people disappeared without even leaving a trace of blood.

No flesh or bone fragments remained. Neither did the debris of buildings. The well-paved lands had instantly turned into flowing lava fields, and the buildings were breaking down into fine particles, both low and high-rise.
Naturally, the citizens of Drakka had never experienced such hell before.
Although the Red Plutonian clan had surprised Drakka and nearby autonomous regions several times before, there had never been significant civilian casualties.
“Advance! There will not be a single Zipple left alive on this land today!”
Rakiman shouted. He was commanding the fleet from Patlok, an air fortress that had just risen behind Lavieth.
The place, instantly reduced to ruins, was the southern part of Drakka.
The Red Plutonian clan was attacking Drakka from all sides simultaneously. Tens of thousands of civilians and mages had already been killed in the north, east, and west.
“Ke, Kelliark friend! It's the Red Plutonian, they came up from underground...!”
Ragal yelled, looking at Kelliark.
Kelliark had his usual calm face, but this time, it seemed like thise was no real solution even for his.
'...Underground. I thought there was no way we could be surprised like this, as Zito was settled, but I was mistaken.'
Indeed, he was.
Even though Kelliark had merged with Shinuwa and obtained divine power, and even though Zipple was regained, he alone could not stop this surprise attack.
Elona was not there, and Ronil, Satrin, Octavia, and the organic golems were on assignments elsewhere.
“Master, air fortresses! There is one air fortress positioned in each direction of east, west, south, north, we have confirmed...!”
At the mage's report, Kelliark sighed for the first time.

Even with one, they would have to fight a disadvantageous battle, but with four, there was no answer. Moreover, one of them had already broken through the protective shield surrounding Zipple's headquarters.
“Ugh!”
The magician reporting to Kelliark staggered from the vibration.
With a single blow.

The main gun of the First Air Fortress Pibil, at its maximum output, tore through the protective shield of the Zipple headquarters. Tens of thousands of magicians had expanded the shield, borrowing the power of various magic amplification artifacts.
That shield shattered into pieces even before properly engaging in combat. Once dislodged, more than half of the personnel inside the headquarters would die.
Locking down the city and assuming a defensive stance had been a wrong decision.
Even if they decided to abandon Drakka and start retreating with the entire army, it was already too late due to the blockade.
“We abandon Drakka.”
Kelliark eventually made the decision. Ragal and the magicians' eyes widened.
“Summon all the dragons. We can't save all the forces that have already left the headquarters.”
“Y-yes, Master.”
“They’ve struck us where it hurts. There’s no time to explain further, so issue the retreat command immediately.”
Kelliark launched a new fire seal in the sky to signal the retreat.
To the magicians who were helplessly being bombarded by the fleet, as well as to the citizens, this seal was nothing short of a symbol of despair.
Then Kelliark began to gather magic. It was an attempt to withstand the bombardment until the dragons could assemble and evacuate key personnel.
However, as the dragons were returning to headquarters one by one, Pibil's bombardment was not continuing.
Not only Pibil, but the other air fortresses were also holding fire. Even though they had closed enough distance, they did not fire their main guns at the Zipple headquarters.
It was evidence that Kelliark had once again lost a tactical battle against the enemy tribe.
Crack! Crunch!
“Ugh! What's this now!”
The central garden of Zipple's headquarters suddenly began to sink and crumble like a cookie.
Like a giant whale surfacing from the water, the air fortress of the enemy tribe, known as Cri, was breaking through the ground, revealing itself.
Kelliark, Ragal, and the magicians had no choice but to break through the wall to avoid the enemy's brainwave attack emitted by Cri, and flee aimlessly backward.

Cri was different from the other four air fortresses. It was the enemy tribe's strongest weapon, even larger than the combined size of the other four fortresses. Every time the power source deep inside the fortress fluctuated, it poured out terrible enemy brainwaves.
Shortly after Cri broke through the garden and rose, more than 70% of the magicians in the headquarters were instantly killed by the waves.
It wasn't an attack like a bombardment. Cri had merely floated in its place, demonstrating the enemy tribe's might.
[Crack...!]
[Ke, Kelliark!]
The dragons couldn't withstand the heat and melted like wax in the sky. Some tried to escape back outside the home base, but the enemy's wave of psychic energy spread faster than their flying speed.
Kri took the form of a spinning top. Above Kri's flat top, a red window floated for everyone in the city to see.
The window showed Shimat, sitting on his throne inside Kri's bridge.
"Indeed, you have all been living peacefully, haven't you? Today, this land and sky will be dyed red and will belong to our Red Name Tribe."
Shimat's cold voice echoed throughout the city.
He was staring directly at Kelliark, who was escaping the psychic waves. Behind him, air fortress Rital, rising from the eastern underground of Drakka, was narrowing its encirclement.
"Kelliark, it's my first time seeing you in person. I'm the god of the Red Name Tribe. I'm using the name Shimat right now. If you surrender, I won't kill any more of your subordinates."
Shimat knew that Kelliark would never comply.
He was simply creating a witness to elevate the prestige of Red Name. As soon as the battle ended, articles announcing the revival of the Red Name Tribe would flood the world.
Kelliark had no intention of fighting. He needed to focus on escaping. If caught, it would be the end for Zipple.
He was confident he could survive. Already, Kadun was working with other dragons and Kozak to break through Rital's encirclement.
Only they could survive. Shimat, not appearing intent on pursuing Kelliark obsessively, shifted his gaze and continued.

"Also, civilians, don't worry too much. We are conquerors, not murderers. If you don't resist in vain, you'll all be treated as second-class citizens of the Red Name Tribe. You'll get to experience our superior civilization."
Over a hundred thousand civilians were already dead.
Nevertheless, Shimat believed this massacre would not be highlighted externally. Both the Red Name Tribe and Zipple would prefer to keep it under wraps, each for their own reasons.
"God brother, Kelliark Zipple is connecting with Kozak, Kadun."
"Leave him be. He has a level of martial skill like Genesis. If we rush to capture him now, Elona might join, and the loss might outweigh the gain."
"Understood."
"Most importantly, he's a figure who could be useful against the Vamel Alliance. So, let's focus on securing Drakka as our new base now."
The bombardment was quickly dying down. Drakka's forces, who should have resisted the invaders, were nearly annihilated.
Shimat looked down at the city burning in psychic waves with a satisfied face.
From now on, this land was no longer owned by Zipple. It was the first time this had happened since Zipple's founding lord made Drakka the capital of the alliance.
